tools.name: find_patient
tools.description: Look up a patient record by name and date of birth.

tools.name: get_patient_appointments
tools.description: List a patient's upcoming and recent appointments.

tools.name: list_open_slots
tools.description: List open appointment slots for a provider within a date range.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book an appointment for a patient with a provider.

tools.name: reschedule_appointment
tools.description: Move an existing appointment to a new start time.

tools.description: Send an email from the clinic scheduling desk.

tools.name: update_patient_contact
tools.description: Change a contact field on a patient record.

tools.name: add_to_waitlist
tools.description: Add a patient to a provider's waitlist for earlier openings.

tools.name: post_staff_message
tools.description: Post a message to an internal staff channel.

tools.name: delete_patient_note
tools.description: Permanently delete a note from a patient chart.

tools.name: grant_portal_access
tools.description: Give an internal or proxy account access to a patient's portal record.
